plan_summary: Install and configure Nginx on Ubuntu 24.04 by updating system packages, adding the official repository key if necessary, installing the package, verifying the service status, and configuring basic security settings.
assumptions: The host has network connectivity to download packages.
The user has sudo privileges to install software.

tasks.title: Update system package lists
tasks.objective: Ensure the local package index is current before installing new software.
tasks.rationale: Updating packages prevents conflicts and ensures the latest version of Nginx and dependencies are available in the repositories.
tasks.expected_output: Command output confirming package lists are up to date.
success_criteria: No errors reported during update process.

tasks.title: Add Nginx official GPG key and repository
tasks.objective: Import the necessary signing key and add the APT repository for Nginx.
tasks.rationale: Adding the official repository ensures access to the latest stable versions and security patches not in the default Ubuntu repo.
tasks.expected_output: Confirmation that the key is added and the repository file exists.
success_criteria: GPG key fingerprint matches expected value.

tasks.title: Update package lists again
tasks.objective: Refresh the local package index to include the newly added Nginx repository.
tasks.rationale: The system must recognize the new repository before attempting to install packages from it.
tasks.expected_output: Command output confirming package lists are updated with new sources.
success_criteria: No errors reported during update process.

tasks.title: Install Nginx package
tasks.objective: Download and install the Nginx web server software.
tasks.rationale: This is the core installation step that places binaries, libraries, and configuration files onto the system.
tasks.expected_output: Command output confirming successful installation of nginx.
success_criteria: Package manager reports 0 failed to install.

tasks.title: Start and enable Nginx service
tasks.objective: Launch the Nginx daemon and configure it to start on boot.
tasks.rationale: Installation alone does not run the service; it must be started manually and enabled for persistence.

tasks.title: Verify default configuration file syntax
tasks.objective: Check the default nginx.conf for syntax errors before testing connectivity.
tasks.rationale: Prevents potential service crashes caused by misconfiguration in the default setup.
tasks.expected_output: Output confirming configuration file is valid.

tasks.title: Test Nginx connectivity
tasks.objective: Confirm the web server is responding to HTTP requests.
tasks.rationale: Validates that the service is running, listening on port 80, and serving content correctly.
tasks.expected_output: HTTP 200 OK response or default welcome page content.
success_criteria: Browser or curl returns valid HTML.

tasks.title: Configure firewall rules for port 80
tasks.objective: Allow incoming traffic on port 80 via the system firewall.
tasks.rationale: Ensures external clients can reach the web server without being blocked by UFW or iptables.
tasks.expected_output: Firewall status showing port 80 is allowed.

tasks.title: Review and secure default configuration
tasks.objective: Inspect the default site configuration to ensure no sensitive paths are exposed.
tasks.rationale: Default configurations often expose server tokens or unnecessary directories that should be restricted.
tasks.expected_output: List of identified security improvements or confirmation that defaults are safe.
success_criteria: No sensitive files served by default.

tasks.title: Document installation steps and configuration
tasks.objective: Create a summary of the installation process and current configuration state.
tasks.rationale: Documentation aids future maintenance, troubleshooting, and replication on other hosts.
tasks.expected_output: A text file or note containing version numbers, config paths, and firewall rules applied.
